filter.definition: max, over the earlier clock minutes of this market (market open -> the minute before the signal's minute), of each minute's YES-ask close (the last non-null YES ask recorded in that minute)
filter.thresholdFrozen: 0.87, chosen on Dec-May by miro; never retuned

coverage.ifPartialAndAtOrAbove: take (a fuller history can only raise the max)
coverage.ifPartialAndBelow: unknown (not traded by v2, excluded from the pass test, counted and shown)

features.dask1: signal YES ask minus the previous minute's YES-ask close (dollars)
features.d_bps: log(reference price / strike) * 1e4 at the signal, from the desk's 1 s multi-venue reference median (not BRTI; miro used Coinbase 1-min)

pass.test: one-sided Fisher exact: the skipped group's loss rate is greater than the kept group's
pass.fee: the fee charged on the paper fill (Kalshi 1-contract formula ceil(0.07*P*(1-P)*100)/100)
pass.label: UNPROVEN until minV1Signals settled v1 signals with a known v2 decision
